description: One room, standing height, no chairs and no daylight. The left wall is the board: Deadball on the upper half in white chalk, Cluster Puck on the lower half in yellow, every price written in a hand that does not hesitate and rubbed out with the heel of that same hand. The right wall is a shelf at elbow height with a row of little pencils on strings, three of which still have pencils. At the far end is a counter with a brass grille in it and a drawer under the grille that goes both ways. The floor by the bin is an inch deep in torn paper and nobody sweeps it until close.
name: Photo Finish — The Shop
